title: Jet Set Travel Large Pebbled Leather Continental Wallet
description_html:
Jet Set Travel Large Pebbled Leather Continental Wallet by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 8.25"W x 4"H X 1"D
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., 100% leather from tanneries meeting the highest standards of environmental performance
  • Hardware: Gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Zip fastening
